figures.alt: Historic wood double-hung window with localized sill repair and retained surrounding trim
figures.caption: Historic-district work begins with a condition-based understanding of what contributes to the visible character and what changes require review.

figures.alt: Coastal-style elevated home under framing on concrete piers with roof trusses, sandy grade, and erosion-control fence
figures.caption: A rear or upper-story addition is a structural project as well as a design question. New framing, foundation support, roof integration, drainage, and the existing building all need coordination.

figures.alt: Residential interior with wood header, adjustable steel temporary support posts, opened framing, and protected floor
figures.caption: Old-house additions can expose consequential structural conditions. Engineering, temporary support, connections, permits, and the final framing sequence should be resolved before demolition advances.
